description: It reads the list of registrants of one webinar as CSV text, the same export the dashboard downloads: one row per person with the columns the site writes. Take it when a host wants the list as a file for a spreadsheet or another tool. "I need the list in Excel." The text stops at 20000 characters and says so when it was cut, and the full file is the download in the dashboard. Personal data comes only when the licence includes the registrant export. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: registrant list, CSV, export, spreadsheet

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.
